name: trade time derivatives for space derivatives via the equation, then difference
mechanism: expand the next time level as a Taylor series in time, use the governing equation to rewrite each time derivative as a space derivative, then replace those by centred differences on the grid; second-order in both time and space

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Lax–Wendroff for wave equations' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Differential equation solving:

requires: a step ratio inside the stability bound
